'''''Asphodelus bento-rainhae''''' is a species of [[Asphodelus|asphodel]], endemic to the [[Iberian Peninsula]].<ref name="533333-1">{{cite POWO |id=531467-1 |title=''Asphodelus bento-rainhae'' P.Silva |access-date=6 September 2022 }}</ref>

==Taxonomy==
Two subspecies are recognised:<ref name="iberica">{{cite web |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/20_183_31_Asphodelus.pdf |title=''Asphodelus'' L. |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=September 6, 2022}}</ref>
*''Asphodelus bento-rainhae'' subsp. ''bento-rainhae'', endemic to the [[Gardunha]] range, [[Portugal]].
*''Asphodelus bento-rainhae'' subsp. ''salmanticus'' Z.Díaz & Valdés, from western central [[Spain]].
